title: Prescriber Details expansion + Drug Database completeness + warm clinical theme (frontend-only)

requirements.summary: Expand Prescriber Details fields/labels (including exact prefix options) and ensure saved values load consistently per selected patient.
acceptanceCriteria: In the Prescriber Details UI, prefix is a dropdown and the visible option labels are exactly: "Dr.", "Practitioner Nurse", "Pharmacist".
The Prescriber Details UI shows input fields for: Registration Number, Address, Mail ID (email), Contact Number, Specialization.
When a user saves Prescriber Details for a patient, leaving and returning to the patient shows the saved values (view mode and edit mode load the saved data).
User-facing labels use English and include "Mail ID" (not only "Email Address") for the email field.

file_operations.description: Update the Prescriber Details form UI to match requested labels/fields: ensure the prefix dropdown shows exactly "Dr.", "Practitioner Nurse", "Pharmacist" and rename the email label to "Mail ID". Use shadcn-ui form primitives already in use (Select, Input, Textarea, Card, Label) to keep consistent styling; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing. Ensure view mode also reflects the same English labels (e.g., show "Mail ID" instead of "Email") and displays the saved values for the currently selected patient.

Update Case Summary's Prescriber Details section to use consistent English labels (including "Mail ID") and display prescriber values reliably for the selected patient (same prefix labels and field naming). Use existing shadcn-ui Card/Separator structure; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure the prescriber save flow results in consistent reload behavior: after saving, invalidate/refetch the prescriber details query for the affected patientId so leaving/returning to the patient always shows the persisted data (and edit mode hydrates from saved data).

requirements.summary: Tighten Prescriber Details validation: required fields, required valid Mail ID, inline errors, and prevent saving when invalid.
acceptanceCriteria: Attempting to save with any missing required field shows an inline error and the save mutation is not triggered.
Mail ID is required; saving with an empty Mail ID shows an inline error.
Mail ID must match an email pattern; saving with an invalid email shows an inline error.
Contact Number validation accepts phone-like input (digits/spaces/+/-/() ) and rejects clearly invalid input as it does today.

file_operations.description: Update client-side validation: require non-empty registration number, address, contact number, and specialization; require Mail ID to be non-empty and match an email pattern; keep phone-like validation for contact number (digits/spaces/+/-/()). Show errors inline next to each field (using existing error text pattern) and ensure handleSave returns early so the save mutation is not triggered when invalid. Keep all user-facing validation copy in clear English. Use existing shadcn-ui inputs and form layout; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Audit and harden Drug Database UI/data so core fields are complete, render with consistent fallbacks, and banned records always show a Ban Reason & Safety Information section; update curated datasets and normalization rules accordingly.
acceptanceCriteria: Drug list and Drug Details modal never crash due to missing/empty core drug fields; missing values display a consistent English fallback such as "Not available".
Banned drugs always display a clearly labeled "Ban Reason & Safety Information" section populated from the dataset (or a fallback if missing).
Curated drug dataset entries are updated so core fields are populated consistently (no empty string core fields) for records included in the shipped dataset.
Any normalization/deduplication does not remove banned entries in favor of approved entries when duplicates exist (banned must still win).

file_operations.description: Harden Drug Details rendering to consistently treat empty strings as missing values (not only undefined), using a uniform English fallback like "Not available" for core fields. Ensure banned drugs always render a clearly labeled "Ban Reason & Safety Information" section; if dataset safety info is empty/missing, show the fallback rather than rendering blank.

Ensure the drug list/table never crashes when any core fields are missing/empty and displays a consistent "Not available" fallback in table cells and exports for empty core fields. Keep banned/approved filtering stable and ensure any displayed 'source attribution' is resilient to missing/unknown sources.

Update the shipped curated drug dataset so each included record has populated core fields (name, status, category, date, description, source attribution, safety/ban info) and avoids empty strings for those fields. Update normalization/deduplication utilities so duplicates resolve in a way that never drops banned entries in favor of approved entries (banned must win).

Adjust the multi-source drug aggregation/merge logic to normalize empty-string core fields into undefined/"Not available"-friendly values (without breaking types) and to prefer banned records (and their safety info) when merging duplicates across sources. Ensure UI consumers receive consistent, non-crashing values for core fields.

requirements.summary: End-to-end UI review of patient case flow to ensure Prescriber Details and Drug Database modules are complete, consistent, and unblocked (loading/empty/save/error states).
acceptanceCriteria: No obvious broken states in Prescriber Details and Drug Database modules (loading, empty state, save state, error state all render correctly).
Case Summary displays the saved Prescriber Details for the patient without missing-field UI glitches.
Any user-facing text touched by this change is in English and consistent in terminology (e.g., "Mail ID" vs "Email").

file_operations.description: Review and adjust the Case Entry flow wiring for the Prescriber Details tab and Drug Database access (where present) to ensure the selected patientId is passed correctly and that module loading/empty/error states render without placeholders blocking use.

Ensure Prescriber Details module handles all states cleanly: loading, empty (no details recorded), edit, save pending, and save error states. Standardize user-facing copy to clear English (including "Mail ID"). Use existing shadcn-ui components already imported; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure Case Summary renders prescriber details without label inconsistencies or missing-field glitches (use "Mail ID" terminology and stable fallbacks). Use existing Card layout; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Polish Drug Database module state handling (loading skeletons, empty results, refresh/sync pending, and error messaging if hooks provide errors) so it doesn't show broken/placeholder UI that blocks normal browsing.

requirements.summary: Apply a coherent modern clinical theme across Prescriber Details, Drug list/details, and Case Summary using a warm neutral palette (avoid blue/purple), consistent typography, and spacing.
acceptanceCriteria: Prescriber Details, Drug Database, and Case Summary sections share consistent heading styles, form spacing, and card styling.
Theme uses a warm neutral palette (e.g., off-white/stone/charcoal with a green or amber accent), and does not introduce blue/purple as the primary theme colors.
No changes to authentication or routing are required for the theme update.

file_operations.description: Adjust Tailwind theme tokens/colors to support a warm neutral clinical palette (stone/off-white/charcoal with green/amber accent) and ensure primary/secondary accents are not blue/purple. Keep changes compatible with existing components and utility classes.
Update global CSS variables/base styles to align with the warm neutral palette and consistent typography/spacing across affected screens. Avoid introducing new routing/auth behavior.

Update local styling classes (cards/headers/form spacing) to match the warm neutral clinical theme while preserving all behavior. Use existing shadcn-ui Card and form elements; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Align Case Summary styling (headings, section cards, spacing) to the same warm neutral theme; remove blue-forward styling if present and keep functional behavior unchanged. Verify shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.

Replace blue/purple-forward styling (badges, gradients, borders, headings) with warm neutral + green/amber accents while preserving the module’s behavior and layout. Verify shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.

Update Drug Details modal styling to the same warm neutral theme (headings, section containers, badges) while keeping current content and fallbacks intact. Verify shadcn-ui Dialog usage instructions before implementing.
